import bpy
exec("
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
terrain=bpy.data.collections['Reference_Terrain'].objects[0];dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get();bvh=BVHTree.FromObject(terrain,dg)

 if not ob.name.startswith(('Port_LowerHull','Port_Keel','Port_MainHull')):continue
 for v in ob.data.vertices:
  p=ob.matrix_world@v.co
  if p.z>.6:continue
  hit,n,idx,dst=bvh.ray_cast(Vector((p.x,p.y,20)),Vector((0,0,-1)),50)
  if hit:rows.append({'object':ob.name,'x':p.x,'gz':-p.y,'hull':p.z,'ground':hit.z,'gap':p.z-hit.z})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r['gap']);report={'hull_samples':len(rows),'minimum_clearance':rows[0] if rows else None,'intersections':sum(r['gap']<-.001 for r in rows),'worst_samples':rows[:25]}
(LOG/'berth_clearance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print(json.dumps(report))
print('COLLECTIONS',[(c.name,len(c.objects)) for c in bpy.data.collections])
